title: Disgusting + GCD (Constructive Version)
statement: Given up to 10^5 values, each at most 10^5, the task is to raise elements so every pair is coprime or one divides the other; each operation adds an amount coprime to the current value, within n+10 operations and a total no larger than the original sum. Rounding every element up to the next prime works: gcd(a, p-a) = 1 makes it one step, and Bertrand's postulate bounds it.
